title: Vocational training
subtitle: 「職業訓練／職涯導向教育／實務工作訓練／技能培訓」，究竟是哪一種 vocational training？
description: 「職業訓練／職涯導向教育／實務工作訓練／技能培訓」，究竟是哪一種 vocational training？

words.meaning: 以職業為導向的教育；職涯導向教育
words.note: 使用者提供。career-focused education 強調教育內容直接為某類職業或職涯路徑作準備，比一般 academic education 更貼近 employment outcomes。它不一定只包含 hands-on skills，也可包括專業知識與就業準備。
words.example: The college offers career-focused education in healthcare, construction, and digital media.

exercises.original: The programme provides vocational training for students who want to enter specific industries after graduation.
exercises.zh: 該課程為畢業後希望進入特定行業的學生提供職業導向教育。
exercises.upgrade: career-focused education · 以職業為導向的教育；職涯導向教育

options.explanation: enter specific industries after graduation 直接把教育目的指向職涯準備。
強調 hands-on 工作任務、設備和實務操作。 但本題的具體線索是 education linked to specific career destinations；這句真正要表達的是「職涯／就業導向教育」。因此 practical job training 雖然與職業訓練有重疊，培訓層級、對象、內容或交付方式並不最吻合。
聚焦獲得一組明確、可操作的技能。 但本題的具體線索是 education linked to specific career destinations；這句真正要表達的是「職涯／就業導向教育」。因此 skills training 雖然與職業訓練有重疊，培訓層級、對象、內容或交付方式並不最吻合。
正式地指為某個 occupation 作準備的職業訓練。 但本題的具體線索是 education linked to specific career destinations；這句真正要表達的是「職涯／就業導向教育」。因此 occupational training 雖然與職業訓練有重疊，培訓層級、對象、內容或交付方式並不最吻合。
以整體勞動力、地方就業與技能供應為焦點。 但本題的具體線索是 education linked to specific career destinations；這句真正要表達的是「職涯／就業導向教育」。因此 workforce training 雖然與職業訓練有重疊，培訓層級、對象、內容或交付方式並不最吻合。
只針對某個具體職位／崗位的任務與程序。 但本題的具體線索是 education linked to specific career destinations；這句真正要表達的是「職涯／就業導向教育」。因此 job-specific training 雖然與職業訓練有重疊，培訓層級、對象、內容或交付方式並不最吻合。

words.meaning: 實務工作訓練；實際職能培訓
words.note: 使用者提供。practical job training 強調實際操作、工作技能與職場任務，特別適合 hands-on practice、equipment、procedures 和 workplace routines。它比 career-focused education 更偏 skills practice。
words.example: The course includes practical job training in workshop safety and equipment use.

exercises.original: Trainees spend half the course in vocational training using industry equipment.
exercises.zh: 學員有一半課程時間接受使用業界設備的實務工作訓練。
exercises.upgrade: practical job training · 實務工作訓練；實際職能培訓

強調教育與特定職涯或就業路徑直接連結。 但本題的具體線索是 hands-on use of industry equipment；這句真正要表達的是「實際職務操作訓練」。因此 career-focused education 雖然與職業訓練有重疊，培訓層級、對象、內容或交付方式並不最吻合。

專指木工、電工、焊接等 skilled trades 的培訓。 但本題的具體線索是 hands-on use of industry equipment；這句真正要表達的是「實際職務操作訓練」。因此 trade training 雖然與職業訓練有重疊，培訓層級、對象、內容或交付方式並不最吻合。

exercises.original: The centre offers vocational training in food preparation, machine operation, and workplace safety.

exercises.upgrade: practical job training · 實務工作訓練；實際職能培訓

exercises.original: Students receive vocational training before beginning their work placement.

exercises.upgrade: practical job training · 實務工作訓練；實際職能培訓

words.note: 較廣。skills training 強調獲得特定可操作技能，可以是職業技能、技術技能或工作場所技能。它不一定構成完整 vocational education programme。
words.example: The scheme provides skills training in welding and electrical installation.

exercises.original: The initiative provides vocational training in welding, plumbing, and basic electrical work.
exercises.zh: 該計劃提供焊接、水喉和基本電工方面的技能培訓。

falseSynonyms.zh: career-focused education 強調教育與職涯結果的連結；vocational training 可以更直接、實務、短期或技能導向。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The college provides career-focused education in healthcare. The centre provides short vocational training courses.

falseSynonyms.zh: skills training 只要求教授特定技能，未必構成完整職業教育路線。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Workers receive skills training on the new software. The college offers a two-year vocational training programme.

falseSynonyms.zh: technical training 只在內容確實屬設備、技術系統、工程程序等 technical domain 時適合。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Engineers receive technical training. Hospitality staff receive vocational training.

falseSynonyms.zh: apprenticeship 是一種制度／職位安排；apprenticeship training 是其中的培訓部分。不是所有 vocational training 都透過 apprenticeship 提供。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She started an apprenticeship with an electrician. Her apprenticeship includes structured training.

falseSynonyms.zh: on-the-job training 明確是在工作場所、工作期間學習；vocational training 也可以在學院、訓練中心或工作坊進行。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He learned through on-the-job training. She completed vocational training at college.

falseSynonyms.zh: professional development 通常針對已在職人士持續提升專業能力；vocational training 常包含初次進入職業所需的基礎訓練。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Teachers attend professional development. Trainees complete vocational training before employment.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者可互補，但概念不同。academic education 通常更偏理論、學科知識與學術資格；vocational training 更直接連結職業技能與工作準備。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The course includes academic study. The programme also includes vocational training.

falseSynonyms.zh: work experience 是實際接觸工作環境；它可以沒有結構化教學，因此不等於 vocational training。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Students complete two weeks of work experience. They receive structured vocational training before placement.
